title: netherite_crafting
description: This datapack adds custom crafting recipes for creating netherite tools and armor directly, without requiring the default upgrade system. It simplifies progression and gives players more flexibility when obtaining netherite gear.
body:
Craft all netherite tools directly in a crafting table 
Craft full netherite armor without upgrading diamond gear
Simple and easy-to-use recipes
Works in both singleplayer and multiplayer
Instead of upgrading diamond items, players can place the required materials into a crafting table to receive netherite tools or armor instantly.
